answers.ask: How big is one factory plot at full expansion, and are the eight areas one continuous world or separate places?
answers.answer: Use a compact factory plot that expands to roughly a 60x60-stud footprint at full expansion, enough for a clear automated production line without becoming overwhelming. Make the eight factory areas separate themed zones within one continuous world, unlocked in progression order.

answers.ask: Is the collecting ground shared by the whole server, or does each player have their own patch?
answers.answer: Use a shared collecting ground in each world area so players can see one another collecting and compete for rare spawns. Keep object respawns frequent so the shared space stays rewarding for everyone.

scene_prompt: Create a colorful 3D factory-world map with eight separate themed zones connected in one continuous progression path: Starter, Candy, Toy, Technology, Volcano, Space, Galaxy, and Secret Factory areas. Each zone has a shared collecting ground where basic and rare objects spawn, with visible routes leading to individual player-owned factory plots. Each factory plot begins small and expands to roughly a 60x60-stud footprint, organized as a clear automated production line: object intake at the front, conveyor belts carrying objects through crusher, cutter, melter, press, laser, recycler, duplicator, rainbow, galaxy, and secret machines, then finished-object outputs at the back. Use open sightlines so players immediately see the collect-to-factory flow, with animated belts, processing chambers, storage areas, and space for expanding machinery. Include a central shared-event space in the world with enough open sky and ground for oversized falling objects, golden-object rain, rainbow effects, or a large black-hole landmark.
agent_notes: A collect-process-earn-upgrade loop with prestige, pets and unlocking areas is Simulation and specifically the Incremental Simulator preset; nothing else in the prompt is a second genre. This is the extraction hybrid the genre notes describe, so I swapped the preset's world-open for plot-isolated and added resource-shared: each player owns their own factory plot, but the answers make the collecting ground shared across every world area, and building that field as somebody's plot would break the loop. collectible-nodes are the apples, rocks and diamonds spawning on that field, physics-rig is the crusher, cutter and melter line whose bouncing, rolling, breaking reactions are the entire selling point, gate-progression the eight areas unlocking in order, and trigger-rebirth the RESTART pad. The answers settle the P4 question in favour of one continuous world, so the eight themed areas are zones on one surface and the whole build stays on P0; I also decided without a user that the server-wide events are timed dressing over the shared field rather than hazard zones, since none of them actually kills anyone.
